blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No player won the Grand Lotto 6/55 and Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpots on Wednesday, Nov. 25, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. Grand Lotto 6/55 draw result: 36-30-15-17-24-42. Jackpot prize: ₱45.08 million Mega Lotto 6/45 draw result: 35-32-12-37-16-41 Jackpot prize: ₱39.51 million Minor games The PCSO also reported the following results for its minor lottery games: The 3D Lotto and 2D Lotto draws carried prizes of ₱4,500 and ₱4,000, respectively. Draw schedule Grand Lotto 6/55 draws are held every Monday, Wednesday and Saturday, while Mega Lotto 6/45 draws take place every Monday, Wednesday and Friday....
